principle.id: Nilai menilai proses, bukan untung atau rugi. Proses yang benar tetap bernilai baik walaupun kena SL; proses yang salah tidak mendapat nilai tambahan karena kebetulan untung.
principle.en: The score judges the process, never the profit or loss. A sound process still scores well when it hits the SL; a poor one earns nothing extra for a lucky profit.

risk.measure: risk_pct = |entry − SL| in pips × pip value per lot (USD) × lot ÷ balance × 100

volatility_part.measure: sl_atr = |entry − SL| ÷ ATR(14) at Start (key: numbers.atr14_pips)

bonus.when: SL beyond numbers.invalidation_level (or no level given)

reasons.rule: 6 × (valid reasons chosen ÷ reasons chosen); 0 with no reason

cases.case: ran to SL, TP or the window's auto-close
manual close with a valid close reason (structure_broken, news_ahead, target_area)
manual close before the target without a valid reason (small_profit, bored)
panic close near the SL without a new signal (fear)

scenario_no_trade.rule: When decision.ideal is no_trade the whole score is decision and reasons.

pending_unfilled.rule: A pending order that never fills is scored on the decision only: decision points × 5 (out of 100); lot, SL and TP aren't scored.

mcq_complex.rule: Per option: +1 ÷ k for each right option chosen, −1 ÷ k for each wrong option chosen (k = number of right options); floor 0, max 1.

report.id: Hasil akhir berupa umpan balik per aspek (risiko, SL, TP/R:R, keputusan, manajemen posisi) dan level Learn 101 yang perlu diulang, dihitung dari soal PG yang salah per level. Tanpa peringkat dan tanpa perbandingan antar pengguna.
report.en: The result is feedback per aspect (risk, SL, TP/R:R, decision, position management) and the Learn 101 levels to revisit, from the wrong answers per level. No ranking and no comparison between users.

name.id: Exit poll dan hasil pemilu Inggris
name.en: UK election exit poll and results

decision.id: Exit poll keluar sekitar tiga jam setelah Mulai dan bisa menggerakkan poundsterling ratusan pip dalam hitungan menit. Membuka posisi sebelumnya berarti bertaruh pada hasil yang belum diketahui, dengan risiko spread melebar dan slippage. Sikap menghindar atau menunggu sesudahnya (Level 5) adalah keputusan yang tepat.
decision.en: The exit poll lands about three hours after Start and can move sterling hundreds of pips within minutes. Opening a position before it means betting on an unknown result, with the risk of wide spreads and slippage. Staying out or waiting for afterwards (Level 5) is the right decision.

name.id: The Fed menaikkan bunga untuk pertama kali sejak 2006
name.en: The Fed's first rate hike since 2006

decision.id: Struktur M15 turun sesudah keputusan, dan arah kebijakan dua bank sentral berbeda: The Fed mulai mengetatkan, ECB masih melonggarkan. Lower high terakhir cukup jauh dari harga, jadi sell langsung membuat SL lebar dan R:R buruk; pending sell limit di area pullback lebih dekat ke level itu. Ini sesuai sikap "menunggu sesudahnya" di Level 5.
decision.en: The M15 structure is falling after the decision, and the two central banks are moving apart: the Fed starting to tighten, the ECB still easing. The last lower high is well above price, so selling now means a wide SL and poor R:R; a pending sell limit in the pullback area sits closer to that level. This fits the "wait for afterwards" approach in Level 5.

b.en: The review focuses on process, not profit targets.

explanation.id: Selisih jam WIB dengan New York atau London berubah dua kali setahun karena DST.
explanation.en: The gap between WIB and New York or London changes twice a year because of DST.

explanation.id: Slippage umumnya terjadi saat likuiditas rendah atau volatilitas tinggi; slippage positif ada tetapi lebih jarang.
explanation.en: Slippage usually happens when liquidity is low or volatility is high; positive slippage exists but is rarer.

explanation.id: 1 pip = 0,01 × 100.000 = 1.000 JPY; 1.000 ÷ 125,00 = $8,00. Nilainya berubah mengikuti kurs.
Tren berlaku sampai terbukti rusak; yang menentukan adalah struktur dan close, bukan satu candle.
explanation.en: A trend holds until proven broken; structure and the close decide, not a single candle.

explanation.id: Tiga lapis dengan jarak sekitar 4–6 kali antar lapis; terlalu banyak lapis malah membingungkan.
explanation.en: Three layers about 4–6 times apart; too many layers only confuse.

explanation.id: Bearish engulfing menunjukkan potensi pembalikan dari bullish menjadi bearish.
explanation.en: A bearish engulfing shows a potential turn from bullish to bearish.

explanation.id: SL menjawab "di mana ide ini salah?" dan diberi buffer di luar level penting.
explanation.en: The SL answers "where is this idea wrong?" and gets a buffer beyond the key level.

explanation.id: Free margin adalah sisa dana yang bebas dipakai membuka posisi baru atau menanggung rugi.
explanation.en: Free margin is the money left free to open new positions or absorb losses.

explanation.id: Risiko 30 pip, imbalan 90 pip, jadi RRR 1:3.
explanation.en: 30 pips of risk against 90 pips of reward, so the RRR is 1:3.
(close − low) ÷ (high − low) = 0.0040 ÷ 0.0050 = 0.8: buyers controlled the close.

explanation.id: Mata uang melemah menguntungkan eksportir dan merugikan importir serta konsumen barang impor.
explanation.en: A weaker currency helps exporters and hurts importers and buyers of imported goods.

explanation.id: 0,5⁴ = 6,25%. Dalam ratusan transaksi, rangkaian seperti ini hampir pasti terjadi.
explanation.en: 0.5⁴ = 6.25%. Over hundreds of trades, a run like this is almost certain to happen.

explanation.id: Contoh di materi: rugi −3R ditelusuri sampai akar masalahnya, yaitu ukuran risiko yang terlalu besar.
explanation.en: The lesson's example traces a −3R loss back to its root: a risk size that was too big.
